description.value: Kumare Restaurant & Bakery is a Richmond Filipino restaurant celebrating the regional diversity of Filipino cuisine through an extensive menu of silog breakfasts, soups, mains, and classic pastries. The business also operates a street food truck serving pop-ups and community events across the Lower Mainland, and ships authentic Filipino baked goods throughout BC. A touring cyclist will find a community-oriented dining destination with broad dietary accommodation and dedicated takeout and boxed lunch services.
